summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned Enterprise C2C Staffing Lead Platform - Candidate Portal. All candidate pages tested successfully. Fixed a bug in BusinessLeads.js where old field names were used in filter logic. All features working correctly including login, navigation, filters, modals, and data display with new field names.

ui_bugs.issue: Theme toggle button in dashboard header is not visible (hidden lg:flex class issue). Works correctly on login page.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: BusinessLeads.js was using old field names (title, company, engagementType, workMode) in filter logic - updated to new field names (role_title, author_company, engagement_type, work_mode)
All candidate pages are well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes
Mock data migration to new field names is complete and working
Sidebar navigation correctly shows 'Jobs Explorer' (not 'Job Leads')
All modals (job detail, email preview, upload resume, delete confirmation) work correctly
test_credentials: candidate@demo.com / candidate123 (via demo credential button), business@demo.com / business123 (via demo credential button)
seed_data_creation: N/A - All data is mocked via mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All candidate pages tested: /candidate/dashboard, /candidate/jobs, /candidate/resume, /candidate/recruiters. Business pages regression tested: /business/dashboard, /business/leads. Fixed BusinessLeads.js filter logic to use new field names. Theme toggle works on login page but not visible on dashboard header (known issue from iteration_2).

features_tested.candidate_login_flow: PASS - Demo credentials fill form, login redirects to dashboard
features_tested.candidate_dashboard: PASS - 5 KPI stat blocks (Jobs Scraped Today, Matching Jobs, Applications Sent, Response Rate, Profile Views), Application Pipeline donut charts, Weekly Activity bar chart, Resume Health section (ATS Score 95), Latest Scraped Jobs list with new field names (role_title, author_company, engagement_type, rate_raw), Recent Activity feed, Top Skills in Demand
features_tested.jobs_explorer: PASS - Table with role_title, engagement_type, work_mode, location, rate_raw, visa_constraints, source, scraped_at columns. Expandable row shows raw_text & skills. Hover on row shows 'Send to Apply' button. Eye icon opens detail modal with all job details. ArrowSquareOut icon opens source URL. Filter sidebar with keyword search, engagement type, work mode, date scraped, has contact toggle, rate present toggle
features_tested.recruiter_directory: PASS - Simple table with Name, Company, Phone, Email, LinkedIn, Automate columns. Search bar filters by name/company. Robot icon hover shows email preview tooltip. Robot icon click opens email preview modal with template body and Send Email button. NO filter sidebar (correct - simple table design)
features_tested.resume_lab: PASS - Table with resume name (default badge on default resume), skills tags (hover +N more to see full list), ATS score bar, updated date, actions (edit/download/set-default/delete). Filter sidebar with search, skill tags, min ATS score, last updated, default only toggle. Upload modal works. Delete confirmation modal works. Master Resume Profile stats section (Completeness 85%, Best ATS Score 95/100, Total Skills 52)
features_tested.sidebar_navigation: PASS - Shows 'Jobs Explorer' label (NOT 'Job Leads'), no 'Matches' entry
features_tested.business_dashboard: PASS - Renders correctly with new field names (role_title, author_company, engagement_type, work_mode, rate_raw)
features_tested.business_job_leads: PASS - Renders with new field names. Filters now work correctly after fix
features_tested.dark_mode_toggle: PASS on login page, NOT VISIBLE on dashboard header

bugs_fixed.fix: Updated to new field names (role_title, author_company, engagement_type, work_mode)
